baseline.output: DLinear output in the same standardized space

last_center.input: subtract each input window's last observed value per channel
last_center.output: add the same causal anchor to DLinear output
last_center.training_rows: same windows and paired random sample stream as baseline

mean_center.input: subtract the mean of the 32 observed input values per channel
mean_center.output: add the same causal anchor to DLinear output
mean_center.training_rows: same windows and paired random sample stream as baseline

selective_center.input: subtract last observed value only for named channels; leave remaining standardized channels unchanged
selective_center.output: add the same anchor only to named output channels
selective_center.selection_basis: D003; both channels improved NMSE in preceding two development runs; this is validation-driven selection
selective_center.training_rows: same windows and paired random sample stream as baseline
